definitions.name: F1A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: index of the first largest number in a Vector

definitions.name: F1A.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TK' BIND TK KEYS TK VALUES F1A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: key of a Record whose value is largest, first on ties

definitions.name: F1A.UNWORDS
definitions.note: join a Vector of words with single spaces

definitions.name: F1A.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: a word with first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: F1A.TITLE
definitions.note: String -> its words capitalized, joined by single spaces

definitions.name: F1A.LBY
definitions.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] pairs -> Record name to sum of amounts

definitions.name: F1A.DIVS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD G0A.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending

definitions.name: F1A.BIN
definitions.body: 'BN' BIND [ 1024 512 256 128 64 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] [ BN GT NOT ] FILTER 'BP' BIND BN BP DIV FLOOR 2 G0A.MOD STR JOIN

definitions.name: F1A.CNEXT
definitions.body: 'CX' BIND CX 2 DIV CX 3 MUL 1 ADD CX 2 G0A.MOD 0 EQ SELECT 'CY' BIND 1 CY CX 1 EQ SELECT

definitions.name: F1A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'CN' BIND CN 1 COLLECT 1 200 RANGE CN [ 'CE' BIND F1A.CNEXT ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH

definitions.name: F1A.PRICE0
definitions.body: 'price' GET 'PP' BIND 0 PP PP NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: order Record -> its price, or 0 when it has none

definitions.name: F1A.LINE
definitions.body: 'OD' BIND OD 'qty' GET OD F1A.PRICE0 MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price (0 when unpriced)

definitions.name: F1A.REVENUE
definitions.note: orders JSON -> total qty times price over priced orders

definitions.name: F1A.TAGS0
definitions.body: 'tags' GET 'TG' BIND [ ] TG 2 COLLECT 0 1 TG NIL? SELECT GET
definitions.note: order Record -> its tags Vector, or an empty Vector

definitions.name: F1A.QBS
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: orders JSON -> Record sku to summed qty

definitions.name: F1A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'ML' BIND MS ML 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS ML 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

definitions.name: F1A.MODE
definitions.body: TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS 'MK' BIND MK ORDER 'MP' BIND MK MP GET MT VALUES MP GET F1A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: most frequent element, smallest on ties

solutions.ledger.debtors: F1A.LBY 'DB' BIND DB KEYS DB VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE ZIP 1 GET F1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: F1A.TITLE
solutions.number.primes: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE [ F1A.DIVS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
solutions.orders.unpriced: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: G0C.ORDERS [ F1A.TAGS0 UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.series.mad: 'MD' BIND MD MD F1A.MEDIAN SUB F1A.ABS F1A.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'MW' BIND MW -2 DROP MW 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MW 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.stats.range: 'RG' BIND RG SORT -1 GET RG SORT 0 GET SUB
solutions.stats.normalize: 'NV' BIND NV SORT 0 GET 'NMIN' BIND NV SORT -1 GET 'NMAX' BIND NV NMIN SUB NMAX NMIN SUB DIV
solutions.text.longest: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.text.acronym: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
